# Dictionary.com

> > Dictionary.com provides comprehensive language resources, word tools, and educational games powered by trusted lexicographic content.

Dictionary.com offers a suite of word-related tools including anagram solvers, crossword helpers, and Scrabble finders, alongside casual puzzle games developed in partnership with Arkadium. The platform serves both mobile (Android, iPhone) and web users with free resources for language learning and entertainment.

## Key Topics

- Dictionary.com
- Anagram Solver
- Crossword Solver
- Scrabble Word Finder
- Word Search Maker
- Hurdle Game
- Mahjongg Dimensions
- Block Champ
- Arkadium
- Word games
- Puzzle games
- Letter unscrambler
- Mobile apps (Android, iPhone)
- Free online games

## Help & Support

- [Dictionary.com Help Center](https://help.dictionary.com/): Help center for Dictionary.com and Thesaurus.com with FAQs and guides

## Word Tools & Solvers

- [Anagram Solver Online](https://play.dictionary.com/games/dictionary-anagram-solver): Anagram solver tool to unscramble letters for word games and puzzles

## Optional Games & Entertainment

- [10x10 Game](https://play.dictionary.com/games/ten-x-ten): Tetris-like puzzle game with 10x10 grid and block placement mechanics
- [Get 10 Ultimate](https://play.dictionary.com/games/get-10-ultimate): Number puzzle game challenging players to reach 10 and beyond
